description: Known answer for one 3-chunk Session.encrypt, written before the session API derived its PQ-combined key once per message. Produced by the session code of 276afe7 (format-5 snapshots; its encrypt path seals each chunk with sealChunk, whose output tests/fixtures/pq-message-key-0.14.10.json pins to 0.14.10) under Bun 1.4.4: a random hybrid-mlkem768 no-PIN pair exchanged one 24-byte message each way and was serialized; aliceSnapshot was then restored with crypto.getRandomValues replaced by the splitmix64 stream below and Date.now fixed, and encrypted plaintextLength bytes of pattern (i * 131 + 7) & 0xff. root and frameSha512 are that message. bobSnapshot opens it. The same check against HEAD d990895 gave the same bytes in three runs.
rng: splitmix64, state0 = 0x0123456789abcdef, each 64-bit output written little-endian into successive 8-byte groups of every getRandomValues request
